description: Use this when you need to estimate sloped roof area and roofing squares from a measured footprint and pitch. Calculates optional shingle purchase allowance, historical asphalt installation and matched removal scenarios, verified historical standing-seam bid endpoints, and a benchmark subtotal with your separately quoted extras; missing local prices remain get a local quote. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

footprint_sqft.description: Horizontal roof projection including overhangs, in square feet for footprint_sqft, feet for length_ft/width_ft. Provide footprint OR both dimensions.

layers.description: Asphalt removal layers; 0 means no removal. Metal rates do not vary with layers; only 0 or 1 supported.

length_ft.description: Horizontal roof projection including overhangs, in square feet for footprint_sqft, feet for length_ft/width_ft. Provide footprint OR both dimensions.

pitch.description: Rise p in inches per 12 inches horizontal run; geometry only.

quoted_extras.description: Your own total dollars quote for separate items excluded from the installation/removal scope; no assumed surcharge.

waste_percent.description: Optional asphalt purchase allowance only. Not applied to installed bid rates. No sourced midpoint/default.

width_ft.description: Horizontal roof projection including overhangs, in square feet for footprint_sqft, feet for length_ft/width_ft. Provide footprint OR both dimensions.
